title: Procedural Optimus Humanoid
description: A complete 1.73-metre humanoid robot assembled from parameter-curve lofts, pillow panels, exact CSG cuts, angle-limited bevels, five-finger hands, articulated mechanical subassemblies, and object-space procedural PBR materials.
techniques: superellipse loft and parallel-transport spine kernels
pillow-shell panels with paired front and back surfaces
corner-normal splitting across authored sharp edges
filtered object-space procedural roughness and bump
